intro: An inscribed token delivered to aspiring night elf hunters awakening in Shadowglen. Carried by a woodland runner, it bears a summons from the hunter trainer Ayanna Everstride atop the great bough of Aldrassil.

p: Carved with the marks of the hunt, the Etched Sigil is handed to newly awakened night elf hunters as they step into Shadowglen. The token serves as an official notice and welcome from Ayanna Everstride, the local hunter trainer residing high within the hollowed boughs of Aldrassil. Instructing the novice to seek her out, the sigil begins a lifelong tutelage in archery, wilderness tracking, and the ancient night elven bond between stalker and beast.
